Class ShapeClipper2D

Namespace
ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides shared Clipper-backed 2D geometry utilities and configuration for path extraction, clipping, offsetting, shape creation, simplification, winding analysis, and hole filtering.

public static class ShapeClipper2D

Remarks

This type acts as the shared foundation for the higher-level ShapeClipperConversion2D, ShapeClipperTriangulation2D, and ShapeClipperDrawing2D helpers. It reuses static buffers and engine instances to reduce allocations during repeated geometry operations, so it is intended for sequential use and is not thread-safe.

Gets or sets the number of decimal places preserved when converting world-space coordinates to Clipper integer coordinates.

public static int DecimalPlaces { get; set; }

Property Value

int

Remarks

Updating this value also updates the precision used by OffsetEngine and affects the coordinate conversions performed by ShapeClipperConversion2D.

InvScale

Gets the inverse of Scale, used to convert Clipper integer coordinates back to world space.
